description: Parpola's picture identifications with a Dravidian word, from five of his papers, mapped to ICIT sign codes of data/normalized/lipi_observed_faces.jsonl. Compiled on 22 October 2026 before any Tamil compound was looked up.

sources.P1997: Parpola, Asko. 1997. Dravidian and the Indus script: On the interpretation of some pivotal signs. Studia Orientalia 82: 167-192.
sources.P2005: Parpola, Asko. 2005. Study of the Indus script. Transactions of the International Conference of Eastern Studies 50: 28-66.
sources.P2008: Parpola, Asko. 2008. Is the Indus script indeed not a writing system? In Airavati: Felicitation volume in honour of Iravatham Mahadevan, 111-131.
sources.P2009: Parpola, Asko. 2009. 'Hind leg' + 'fish': towards further understanding of the Indus script. Scripta 1: 37-76.
sources.P2010: Parpola, Asko. 2010. A Dravidian solution to the Indus script problem. Chennai: World Classical Tamil Conference.

rules.inclusion: A sign enters when at least one source gives a Dravidian word for what the sign depicts, with Parpola's stance asserted, suggested or alternative, and does not call the sign's reading unresolved. Ligatures and modified signs that Parpola reads as compounds are left out, because their word is itself a compound.
rules.codes: The ICIT codes of a sign are the codes found at the position Parpola describes in the objects he cites by CISI number. The 'bull's head' is the exception: P1997 prints its glyph, which is the ICIT 'jar' 740, and names its ligatures with one and two strokes between the horns (741, 742). The numerals one and two are the ICIT short-stroke codes 001 and 002 by definition.
rules.words: Tamil forms as printed with diacritics in any source; a Proto-Dravidian form without a Tamil form is used without its asterisk, with PD *ṯ written as Tamil ṟ. Forms are listed with the words of Parpola's own published readings first, then his picture words. A form is dropped when its stem under the stated tolerance of REBUS-BASE-RATE-2026-10-21 (vowel length and gemination free, final -m and final vowel removed) equals that of a form already listed, and hyphenated compounds and non-Tamil forms are dropped.

FISH.label: fish (plain)
FISH.evidence: P2010 pdf 14 (H-9, M-410, M-112, M-414); P2005 pdf 25; P2009 pdf 8; P1997 prints mīṉ in aṟu-mīṉ

FIG.label: three-branched fig tree (Parpola no. 123)
FIG.evidence: P2010 pdf 19, fig. 11; P2009 pdf 11; P2005 pdf 28: vaṭam, vaṭa, vaṭa-maram

SPINDLE.label: spindle
SPINDLE.evidence: P2010 pdf 20: *katir, suggested; first sign of M-112 and, varied, of M-241
SPINDLE.code_evidence: M-112 first sign 684; M-241 first sign 683

TWOLONG.label: two long vertical strokes
TWOLONG.evidence: P2010 pdf 26 (veḷ, veḷḷi; picture veḷi suggested); P2009 pdf 22 (veḷ asserted, veḷi alternative); P1997 pdf 9 value vĕ̄ḷ

CRAB.label: crab (Parpola no. 88)
CRAB.evidence: P2009 pdf 14: koḷ, kōḷ asserted; P2005 pdf 30: koḷ suggested, reading kōṇ-mīṉ

EYE.label: dot in circle, eye
EYE.evidence: P2005 pdf 33: kaṇ suggested, kāṇ alternative; P2008 pdf 8

WATER.label: two parallel winding lines, water (Parpola no. 175)

BULLHEAD.label: bull's head (the 'jar' of other sign lists)
BULLHEAD.evidence: P1997 pdf 5 (printed 171): Proto-Dravidian *ā 'cow', Tamil ā and āvu, reconstruction *āṉ; suggested
BULLHEAD.code_evidence: glyph printed in P1997 pdf 4-5; its ligatures with strokes between the horns are ICIT 741 and 742

YOKE.label: yoke-carrier
YOKE.evidence: P1997 pdf 7: kā, kāvu, kāvaṭi 'carrying yoke'

left_out.spear: P1997 gives *koṭi / *kōṭu with sign no. 189 of Parpola 1994 but cites no object by CISI number, so no ICIT code can be fixed
left_out.kaḷam sign: P1997 cites only a Koskenniemi-Parpola text number (2279), with no CISI object
left_out.scorpion, oval, cart: P2009 offers several words for each and calls none of them satisfactory
left_out.compound signs: fig with crab (kōḷi; 777, 778, 782, 797), fish with roof (mai-mīṉ), bull's head with strokes (741, 742), bull's head with yoke-carrier (154, 156, 158), doubled eye (792), framed man, fish with four corner strokes
left_out.offering vessel (700): identified pictorially (P1997) with no Dravidian word

published_pairs.rule: Ordered pairs that Parpola reads as a unit in any of the five papers. They are left out of the blind templates and scored separately as selected templates.
pairs: P1997 deity name + derivative of kā-

known_outcomes.rule: Pairs whose Tamil Lexicon outcome was already reported by REBUS-BASE-RATE-2026-10-21 are left out of every template set.
pairs: numerals one to ten with mīṉ, exploratory.json E2
